# GameBix

> A hand-picked browser game arcade. Games run inside the page: no downloads, no accounts, no redirects.

## Sections

- [Full arcade](https://ahmerclub.github.io/index.html): every playable game
- [Categories](https://ahmerclub.github.io/categories.html): Puzzle, Arcade, Action, Racing, Sports, Shooting, Adventure, Board
- [Guides](https://ahmerclub.github.io/guides.html): browser game performance and setup
- [Tools](https://ahmerclub.github.io/tools.html): screen, device and connection checks
- [About](https://ahmerclub.github.io/about-us.html)
- [Contact](https://ahmerclub.github.io/contact-us.html): kashiahmer@mkm.fan

## Guides

- [How Browser Games Actually Work (and Why Some Load Slowly)](https://ahmerclub.github.io/guide-how-browser-games-work.html): What is really happening between pressing play and seeing the game: engines, assets, WebGL and the three bottlenecks that make a browser game feel slow.
- [Stop Browser Game Lag: A Checklist That Actually Works](https://ahmerclub.github.io/guide-stop-browser-game-lag.html): Work through the real causes of lag in order — network, device, display and browser settings — before you blame the game.
- [Playing Browser Games on a Phone: The Settings That Matter](https://ahmerclub.github.io/guide-play-games-on-your-phone.html): Landscape, fullscreen, battery saver and touch controls — the four settings that decide whether a browser game feels good on a phone.

- Linking to any page is allowed.

- Do not scrape or re-host the catalogue.
